why: B delivers the modern, sober black-and-dark-wood study the client described: a dark wood desk sized for the window, a true black ergonomic chair, a low wide bookcase and a compact black leather-look armchair. Its only slips are the light wood bookcase top and the reception-style chair's reddish legs. A mixes a reddish traditional desk, a gray wingback swivel that isn't ergonomic, a tall narrow shelf and a bulky brown nailhead recliner, so it reads as an incoherent, traditional look for this small white room.
